notes: Proposal only. Require a clean committed candidate and passing unmodified/restored controls.
tests selects whole Jest suites; why identifies the intended executed assertion.
Import, syntax, configuration, dependency, launch and fixture-setup failures are not causal kills.
Inspect assertion evidence even when the runner reports killed. In particular, an infrastructure error wrapped in an expect assertion is still infrastructure.
Single-line anchors were individually verified unique. Recheck exact bytes at the committed sweep head.

mutants.why: T-0192 failed HTTP envelopes retains HTTP diagnosis for null: must reject with message HTTP 503, status 503 and body null. A runtime TypeError instead of that API diagnosis is the intended behavioural regression.
T-0192 Settings save owns only the submitted draft keeps 42 unsaved after a held save of 41 from baseline 40 succeeds: later draft must remain visible and unsaved.
T-0192 bulk default feedback distinguishes SQLite success from YAML refusal for HTTP200 semantic errors: feedback must identify YAML refusal rather than unconditional success.

T-0192 boot recovery survives earlier boot failures recovers interrupted Research and Chat work on a healthy boot: research recovery must execute once before startup. Failure-path cases also require the sweep.

T-0192 public route contracts reauthorises at response settlement after success, and the caught error variant: a revoked held request must receive the refusal rather than its original response.
T-0192 public route contracts preserves fixed and dynamic helper errors for Error: the fixed helper must retain its exact published message and 500 status.
T-0192 tooling environment precedence TS loader: nonempty shell wins: file loading must not replace the inherited nonempty value.
T-0192 tooling environment precedence deploy file values replace inherited values including empty; last duplicate wins: deploy intentionally differs from TS shell-wins semantics.
T-0192 tooling environment precedence deploy preserves a lone ' quote as a literal value, and its double-quote variant: a single quote must not be treated as a paired delimiter.

T-0192 script typecheck contract actual mandatory compiler command refuses a planted .mts error then accepts its correction without running the CLI: the intended failure is that the compiler no longer diagnoses the planted TS2322 in the omitted .mts file. Invalid configuration, missing npm/sh or another compiler setup failure must not count. The explicit coverage-list assertion is supporting structural evidence only.

new template identifiers preserve independent creations does not collide when clock and ordinary random values repeat: three successful creations must receive distinct IDs. The constant retains UUID shape so collision is the intended assertion.

The actual Template name input stops publishing edits while the 43 hook-to-modal bindings remain unchanged. Require the real-controls save case to reach its saved payload assertion and observe the original name instead of Edited template; a mapping-only failure is insufficient.
Composer launch control opens the review rather than running: Review must leave onRun uncalled and display the review heading. The confirmation control remains in the same suite.
T-0192 route-local terminal catch contracts Missions list: exact terminal log and 500 for Error: require the exact original route/context/message and exactly one terminal log.
